source.document: WHO SMART Guidelines — Antenatal Care (DAK L2)

regle_metier: If the woman has not yet been fully immunized against tetanus, she should be immunized

regles.annotation: Pregnant women should be vaccinated with trivalent inactivated influenza vaccine at any stage of pregnancy
regles.reference: Vaccines against influenza WHO position paper (2012) (10)
Vaccines against influenza WHO position paper (2012) (10)

regles.action: Provide tetanus toxoid immunizations – using the "Tetanus toxoid-containing vaccine (TTCV) immunization – NO PREVIOUS" schedule (3 dose scheme)
regles.annotation: Tetanus toxoid (TT) vaccination is recommended for all pregnant women who are not fully immunised against TT to prevent neonatal mortality from tetanus
regles.reference: WHO ANC recommendations (2016): C.5. Tetanus toxoid vaccination (3)  Maternal immunization against tetanus (IMPAC) (2006) (11)

regles.action: Provide tetanus toxoid immunizations – using the "Tetanus toxoid-containing vaccine (TTCV) immunization – WITH PREVIOUS" schedule (1 dose scheme)
regles.annotation: 1–4 doses of TTCV in the past: – 1 dose scheme: Woman should receive one dose of TTCV during each subsequent pregnancy to a total of five doses (five doses protects throughout the childbearing years)
regles.reference: WHO ANC recommendations (2016): C.5. Tetanus toxoid vaccination (3)  Maternal immunization against tetanus (IMPAC) (2006) (11)
